verdict: Paid ads are paused; organic reach is softening and being watched closely.
narrative: No paid spend ran in the last 28 days, which means zero paid leads came in during this period — your Google Business Profile was the only active traffic source, delivering 178 actions including 63 calls and 115 website clicks. That organic activity is now under pressure: GBP actions dropped 51.61% in the most recent week, with three consecutive days of zero actions at the close of the period, and search clicks fell 10.11% over the same stretch. The paid campaigns are gated on a contract extension that is currently being finalized, and two intake tools — SMS automation and phone access — are also pending setup that is overdue. Once those items are cleared, paid campaigns are scheduled to relaunch with a retargeting audience already queued for upload by end of September.
